title: AtlasQualityPolicy
description: Versioned decision policy for quality evidence, quality bands and recommendation readiness. Policies are data, never view-template logic; thresholds are only present when justified in the policy rationale. Specification version 0.6.0 (Phase 6, pre-1.0).

rules.description: Documented rule values (categories, allowed sets, required conditions). No opaque magic numbers.

source_assumptions.description: Explicit assumptions about sources, freshness and comparability this policy relies on.
